_meta.description: Daily-rotation model for the story/side/event QUESTS (the /quests board's dungeon quests, distinct from town JOBS which live in job_pools.json). Authoritative quest bodies = deploy/static/parsed.json `quests` (171 quests, objectives + dungeon_uuid) resolved through blades_lib generate_quest_data; names = scripts/quest_names.json; rewards = quest_rewards.json; recurring 'Sigil'/event quests = game_events.json served by /gameevents. This file adds (a) a curated daily-ROTATION pool and (b) a deterministic date-keyed selection + level-scaling model for a back-office editor. See the accompanying spec for how quest.rs should consume it.
authoritative: dailyQuestPool[].questId / dungeonId / objectiveCount — from parsed.json (only quests whose dungeon_uuid EXISTS, i.e. completable end-to-end).
nonDungeonQuests — the 6 nil-dungeon quests that MUST be excluded from any dungeon rotation (they crash generate_quest_data).
guessed: The choice of WHICH categories rotate daily (side/bounty/sigil-event) and the per-day counts in `selection` are a faithful design guess — retail rotated jobs (in job_pools.json), not these story quests, on a daily board. Treat this file as the emulator's 'daily featured quest' offering, editable in back-office.
levelScaling multipliers are guesses aligned to the job difficulty curve; tune per playtest.
_meta.consumedBy: server/src/quest.rs (NOT YET WIRED — see spec). Suggested: a quests_daily::select(date, playerLevel) that mirrors jobs_gen: deterministic pick keyed by the UTC day index, level-scaled difficulty, quest bodies via generate_quest_data. The /quests handler already returns game_event_quests arrays as empty TODO; a daily-quest board can populate a parallel array or reuse the jobs pipeline.

selection._meta: Deterministic daily selection: dayIndex = floor((now_utc - 0) / 86400) shifted to the 05:00 reset boundary. pick N quests = stable hash(dayIndex, poolCategory, slot) % pool.len, de-duplicated. Every player sees the SAME daily featured set (unlike jobs, which are per-character); it changes at the 05:00 UTC day boundary.
selection._note: count values GUESSED. dedupeAcrossDays=1 means avoid repeating yesterday's picks where the pool is large enough.

levelScaling._meta: generate_quest_data currently hardcodes difficulty_level=1, enemy_level=1, given_xp=1000 (see blades_lib/src/util/quest.rs) — every dungeon quest spawns level-1 enemies regardless of player level. This block is the SCALING TABLE a fixed generator should read. GUESSED, aligned to the job difficulty curve.
levelScaling.givenXpFormula: given_xp = round(base(=100) * enemyLevel * 1.0)  (base 100/level is a guess; retail scales XP with enemy level)
levelScaling.rewardScaling: Quest completion reward comes from quest_rewards.json keyed by questId/gldQuestId (fixed, capture-derived); NOT level-scaled in retail for story quests. Leave as-is.
